scope: Same-preview native concave control input and constructor comparison with Delaunator.
observations: Delaunator matches 15/17 and 17/17 native constructor triangles. The differing two first-face triangles are a diagonal choice in the rectangle at indices 6,7,8,11, which is exactly cocircular. Native initial and final index vectors are identical in both faces. The same-run captured 3D coordinates and initial indices reconstruct all 34 facets of the earlier native concave STL export as an unordered multiset.
limitations: One concave fixture does not establish general native tie rule or constraint behavior.
Index equality does not capture native seam identity, winding, or GUI/MCP lifecycle.
No product modification or acceptance is claimed.
